name: Thwomp NPC2
description: An NPC that is launched away from its starting position when the player triggers a quake with the Pegasus Boots.

fields.name: Text ID
fields.description: Selects the dialogue text. The stored value is the configured value plus 299.

fields.name: Actor Sprite
fields.description: The sprite associated with the NPC character.

fields.name: Return Speed
fields.description: Sets the speed at which the actor returns to its starting position. 0 is the fastest and 3 is the slowest.

fields.name: Y Knockback
fields.description: Sets the vertical displacement relative to the actor's starting position when the player triggers a quake with the Pegasus Boots.

fields.name: Invert Y Knockback
fields.description: Reverses the vertical displacement direction relative to the actor's starting position.

fields.name: X Knockback
fields.description: Sets the horizontal displacement relative to the actor's starting position when the player triggers a quake with the Pegasus Boots.

fields.name: Invert X Knockback
fields.description: Reverses the horizontal displacement direction relative to the actor's starting position.

fields.name: Use Alternate Start Position
fields.description: Makes the actor start at the configured X/Y displacement relative to its original starting position. When the trigger variable is set, the actor returns to its original starting position. The Pegasus Boots have no effect on the actor in this mode.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The variable that triggers the actor to return to its original starting position when using the alternate start position mode.
